description: We are Jucumari Tech Sports, a team formed by Octavio, César, Diego, Danily, Fabricio, and Warren. Octavio and César are skilled in robotics and programming competitions. Diego is excellent at mathematics, Danily and Fabricio are good at business studies, and Warren is talented in metalworking (C2!). We are looking for creative, motivated people interested in technology, engineering, robotics, and innovation.
